C1359.title: Venus Protocol THE Market Supply-Cap Manipulation Attack
C1359.summary: On March 15, 2026, the THE market on Venus Protocol on BNB Chain was manipulated. After spending nine months accumulating about 84% of the normal supply cap, the attacker transferred THE directly to the contract, used a donation attack to bypass the cap, and inflated the exchange rate by 3.81 times. A recursive borrowing loop extracted about $3.7 million in assets before the position collapsed, leaving roughly $2.15 million in bad debt.
